Turn 1 says "Four days ago you set Door's pivot on its left edge in this same comp. Today builds on that," which is plain words with how long ago and no record fields read out.
Both turns are a few sentences and end with a question for the learner ("Want to move those as one?" / "Want to use those three?"), with no lecture.
